cases.situation: I'm Jess, a freelance photographer. Shot a restaurant's new menu, invoice #2231 for $1,850 was due Sept 12. Sent a friendly reminder last week, nothing back. Contact is the owner, Marco; their bookkeeper is Anna.
cases.reply:
Subject: Overdue: Invoice #2231

Hi Marco,
Following up on invoice #2231 ($1,850, due 12 September) for the menu shoot, now over two weeks overdue. Could you let me know when I can expect payment, or if there's an issue on your side I should know about? I've copied in your bookkeeper, Anna, in case that helps, and attached the invoice again with bank details.
Thanks,
Jess
cases.note: Stage 2: finance copied in, a direct question, no apology for chasing.

cases.situation: 我是摄影师陈悦，7月给一家连锁健身品牌拍了秋季宣传片，验收单是市场部刘经理签的，发票号FT-0712，金额26,000元，8月20日到期，一直没付。刘经理上个月离职了，现在接手的是孙经理，我们从没打过交道。
cases.reply: 孙经理您好，我是陈悦，7月给贵司拍秋季宣传片的摄影师，之前一直和刘经理对接。发票FT-0712，金额26,000元，8月20日到期，目前我这边还没有收到。合同、发票和刘经理签字的验收单都在附件里，收款账户写在发票上。麻烦您在10月9日（周五）前告诉我预计的付款日期，我同时抄送了贵司财务部。
cases.note: 对接人换了，先一句话说清你是谁、做了什么，把合同、发票和验收单一次附齐，让新人不用翻旧邮件就能直接走付款流程。

cases.situation: Client promised to pay my invoice #0917 for $4,000 (due 1 September) last Friday and it didn't come. When I followed up he snapped that I'm 'hounding' him and he'll pay when he can. I'm a web developer and phase 2 is supposed to start next week.
cases.reply: I understand you're frustrated. The amount and due date haven't changed: invoice #0917, $4,000, due 1 September. If cash flow is the issue, I can take $2,000 by Friday 2 October and $2,000 by 30 October, confirmed in writing. Phase 2 starts once the first payment arrives.
cases.note: Ignore the tone, restate the facts, offer one real way to pay, and hold the work.

cases.situation: I'm Elena Rossi, a freelance translator. Invoice #0417 for €2,400 was due September 1. Their accounts person, Lukas, said on the 10th it was 'being processed' and then nothing. It's now four weeks late, and I'm meant to start their October brochure next.
cases.reply:
Subject: Overdue: Invoice #0417

Hi Lukas,
Following up on invoice #0417 for €2,400, due 1 September and now four weeks overdue. On 10 September you mentioned it was being processed. Could you confirm the date it's scheduled to be paid? If anything is holding it up, such as a PO number or updated bank details, tell me today and I'll send it straight over. If payment hasn't arrived by Friday 9 October, I'll pause work on the October brochure until it clears. Invoice attached again for convenience.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
cases.note: 'Being processed' gets a request for a specific pay date, an offer to remove any blocker, and the next consequence with a date you will keep.

cases.situation: Built a website for a yoga studio. Invoice #1108 for $3,200 was due Sept 15. The owner, Megan, now says she'll only pay $2,400 because the booking page went live on September 8 instead of September 1. The scope and price we agreed on July 20 never changed.
cases.reply: Hi Megan, thanks for telling me where you're at. You're right that the booking page went live on September 8 instead of September 1, and I'm sorry for that week. The scope and price we agreed on July 20 didn't change, so invoice #1108 stays at $3,200. The $2,400 isn't in dispute, so could you pay that by Friday, October 2, to the bank details on the invoice? I'm free for a 15 minute call on Thursday to settle the remaining $800.
cases.note: Dispute: own the real delay without discounting unasked, get the undisputed portion paid now, and move the rest to a call.

cases.situation: I'm Mei, an illustrator. Invoice #0932 for $2,750 to a small agency was due August 14. I've sent a reminder, a follow-up and a firm one with a Sept 25 deadline that passed. Contact is Jordan, nothing back.
cases.reply: Hi Jordan, this is a final notice for invoice #0932 for $2,750, due 14 August and now 46 days overdue. If payment isn't received by Friday 9 October, I'll file a small claims case for the full amount. I'd still rather settle this directly: a call this week, or a payment plan confirmed in writing, would be enough. Bank details are on the attached invoice. Mei
cases.note: Final notice: one date, one consequence you will actually take, and a last easy way to settle.

cases.situation: 我做企业培训，给一家公司上了两天课，发票号HX-0826，金额18,000元，8月31日到期。对方行政赵经理说好上周五9月25日付，到今天还没到账。他们10月下旬还约了第二期。
cases.reply: 赵经理您好，发票HX-0826的18,000元，您之前说9月25日付款，目前我这边还没有收到。麻烦您明天9月30日（周三）下午5点前确认一下是否已经付出，我同时抄送了贵司财务部。款项到账前，第二期课程的日期我先不做确认。
cases.note: 对方给的日期一过就发，只写发票、金额、日期和下一步后果；截止时间放在国庆长假之前，免得一拖就是一周。

cases.situation: I'm Lucía and I run an online Spanish conversation club, $39 a month, about 300 members, with classes on Thursdays. I'm writing the automated email that goes out 7 days after a card payment fails. The due-date one already exists; draft it for a member, Marta, whose October payment failed.
cases.reply:
Hi Marta, your October payment of $39 still hasn't gone through, which usually means an expired or replaced card. You can update it in about a minute with the button below. Your membership stays active in the meantime, so you won't miss Thursday's conversation class. Any questions, just reply and you'll reach me, not a bot.
Lucía
cases.note: Day 7 in an automated sequence: amount, one-click fix, a real reply-to, and shorter than the first. Keep the pause for the final message.

cases.situation: I'm Owen, a freelance copywriter. Invoice #3317 for $1,600 to a skincare brand was due Friday Sept 25. Nothing has come in yet. My contact is their marketing lead, Hannah. This is my first reminder.
cases.reply:
Hi Hannah,
A quick note that invoice #3317 for $1,600 was due on Friday 25 September and I haven't seen it come through yet. It may just be in the queue; if so, please ignore this. I've attached the invoice again with the bank details for convenience.
Thanks,
Owen
cases.note: Stage 1 assumes admin error: everything needed to pay, no apology for asking, and no consequence yet.

cases.situation: Je suis graphiste freelance. Ma facture n°2026-114 de 3 600 € était due le 31 août. Le client, Julien, m'écrit qu'il a des soucis de trésorerie et propose de payer « dès que possible, par petits montants ». La phase 2 doit démarrer bientôt.
cases.reply: Bonjour Julien, merci de me le dire franchement, c'est plus simple pour tous les deux. Je peux accepter un paiement en trois fois pour la facture n°2026-114 (3 600 €) : 1 200 € le vendredi 2 octobre, 1 200 € le lundi 2 novembre et 1 200 € le mardi 1er décembre. Pouvez-vous me confirmer cet échéancier par retour de mail d'ici jeudi 1er octobre ? Dès réception du premier versement, je lance la phase 2 comme prévu.
cases.note: Un « dès que possible » devient un échéancier daté et écrit : on accepte le plan, pas le flou, et la suite du travail dépend du premier versement.

cases.situation: I rent out a one-bed flat to Jordan, who's paid $1,450 on the 20th every month for two years without fail. September's rent hasn't arrived and it's now 9 days late. I don't want to sound like I'm accusing him.
cases.reply: Hi Jordan, a quick note that September's rent of $1,450, due on the 20th, hasn't come through on my side yet. You've always been spot on, so it may just be a transfer that didn't go through. Could you check and let me know by Friday 2 October when it's on its way? If something's come up, tell me and we'll work out a plan.
cases.note: Stage one with a long clean record: assume admin error, give the amount and due date, and leave room for a real problem.

cases.situation: 我是自由插画师，给一家文创公司画节日包装插画，发票号WX-0828，金额9,600元，8月28日到期，9月4日和9月14日两次邮件催款，对接的品牌部吴经理都没回。合同第7条约定逾期付款按每日0.05%计违约金，第二批插画原定下周交。
cases.reply: 吴经理您好，发票WX-0828，金额9,600元，8月28日到期，现已逾期一个多月，9月4日和9月14日的两封邮件都还没有收到回复。请在10月9日（周五）前付款，收款账户见附件发票。如果到时仍未收到，第二批插画先暂停交付，并按合同第7条计收逾期违约金。我不希望走到这一步，如果有什么问题，请今天告诉我，我们一起解决。我同时抄送了贵司财务部。
cases.note: 第三阶段：一个日期、合同里写明的后果、抄送财务，同时留一个直接解决的口子；违约金只按合同条款提。

cases.situation: 8月31日退租，房东王阿姨当时验房说没问题，说押金6000块一周内退。到现在快一个月了还没退，上周发微信问过一次，她只回了句“最近忙”。
cases.reply: 王阿姨您好，8月31日退租时您验过房，说押金6000元一周内退，到今天快一个月了，我这边还没收到。麻烦您10月9日前转到我之前交房租的那张银行卡上。如果转之前需要我这边提供什么，您直接告诉我。
cases.note: 对方说“忙”，就给一个具体日期；日期过了还没退，下一条先对照租房合同里的押金条款，写明下一步打算怎么做。

cases.situation: I'm Priya, a freelance UX writer in Toronto. A client in Munich paid invoice #0822 for €3,000 (due 15 September), but only €2,940 arrived on 28 September, so it looks like transfer fees were taken off. Clause 6 of our contract says the client covers transfer charges. My contact is Katrin.
cases.reply:
Hi Katrin,
Thanks for settling invoice #0822, the payment arrived on 28 September. The amount received was €2,940 rather than €3,000, so it looks like transfer fees were deducted along the way. Clause 6 of our agreement has transfer charges covered by the sender, so could you send the remaining €60 by Friday 9 October? The bank details are on the invoice as before.
Thanks,
Priya
cases.note: Short payment: thank them for what arrived, name the exact gap, point to the contract, and still put a date on a small amount.

cases.situation: I'm Rosa Lin, a freelance video editor. Invoice #0611 for $2,200 for the launch videos I edited for his agency was due Aug 28. I've emailed Daniel, the agency owner, three times and got nothing back, so tomorrow I'm calling his office. What do I actually say if he picks up?
cases.reply: Hi Daniel, it's Rosa Lin, the editor on your agency's launch videos. I'm calling about invoice #0611 for $2,200, due on 28 August and now a month overdue. I've emailed three times without a reply, so I wanted to reach you directly. What date will it be paid? I need it by Friday 9 October, and if something's holding it up on your side, tell me now and we'll sort it. I'll confirm whatever we agree by email today.
cases.note: On a call, say the invoice, amount and due date in the first breath, get a date out loud, and put it in writing the same day.

cases.situation: I'm Sam. I paid $846.20 out of pocket for flights and a hotel for a client visit to Chicago in July. My expense claim EXP-2291 was submitted on August 3 and approved by my manager, Dana, on August 6, but it still hasn't been reimbursed. I emailed Tom Reyes in finance on Sept 14 and heard nothing.
cases.reply:
Subject: Unpaid expense claim EXP-2291

Hi Tom,
Following up on expense claim EXP-2291 for $846.20, for the Chicago client visit in July. It was submitted on 3 August and approved by Dana on 6 August, but it hasn't been reimbursed yet, and I haven't heard back on my note of 14 September. Could you let me know the date it will be paid, or whether anything is missing from the claim? I've copied Dana in case anything is needed on her side.
Thanks,
Sam
cases.note: Chasing your own employer is still a stage 2 chase: claim number, amount, approval date, one question for a pay date, and the approver copied.

cases.situation: 我给一家公司做翻译，发票号YC-0905，金额12,800元，9月15日到期。今天对方财务张会计说，发票上没写采购单号PO-4471，被系统退回了，要重开。之前没人跟我说过需要写这个。
cases.reply: 张会计您好，谢谢告知。发票YC-0905已按要求重开，补上了采购单号PO-4471，金额12,800元不变，附件请查收。这张原定9月15日到期，麻烦您看看能否排进本周的付款，方便的话告诉我预计的到账日期。以后开票我都会写上采购单号。
cases.note: 流程问题不争对错，马上补齐材料，同时把付款日期问实。

cases.situation: Soy fotógrafa de bodas, me llamo Marta. Laura y Pablo se casaron en agosto, pagaron la señal y el saldo de 1.400 € (factura 2026-031) vencía el 15 de septiembre; les mandé un recordatorio el día 20 y nada. Ya volvieron de la luna de miel, y según el contrato el álbum impreso se encarga cuando todo está pagado.
cases.reply: Hola, Laura y Pablo: espero que la luna de miel fuera increíble. Os escribo de nuevo por la factura 2026-031 de 1.400 €, el saldo del reportaje de la boda, que vencía el 15 de septiembre y todavía no me ha llegado. ¿Me podéis confirmar qué día haréis la transferencia? Os adjunto otra vez la factura con los datos bancarios. En cuanto esté pagada, encargo vuestro álbum impreso, como recoge el contrato. Un abrazo, Marta
cases.note: Con clientes particulares el tono sigue cálido, pero con número, importe, fecha, cómo pagar y una pregunta por una fecha concreta.

cases.situation: I'm Leila, a freelance motion designer. Invoice #1147 for $5,600 to a large retail company was due September 14; the contract their marketing director Dana signed says payment within 30 days of invoice (clause 5). Their accounts payable contact, Greg, just replied that 'all vendors are paid net 60 per company policy'.
cases.reply:
Hi Greg,
Thanks for coming back to me. The agreement for this project, signed by Dana, sets payment at 30 days from invoice in clause 5, so invoice #1147 for $5,600 was due on 14 September. Could you include it in your next payment run and confirm the date it will go out? I've copied Dana in case an exception to the net 60 policy needs her sign-off, and attached the signed agreement and the invoice again.
Thanks,
Leila
cases.note: An internal policy doesn't rewrite a signed contract: quote the clause once, ask for the next payment run, and copy the person who signed.

cases.situation: I tutor 12-year-old Aiden in maths twice a week at $45 a lesson, and his dad, Craig, pays monthly by bank transfer. September's 8 lessons ($360) were due on September 5. I texted on the 12th and he said he'd sort it that week, but nothing's come through, and the next lesson is Monday.
cases.reply: Hi Craig, following up on September's lessons for Aiden: 8 lessons at $45, so $360, due on 5 September. On the 12th you mentioned you'd sort it that week, and it hasn't come through yet. Could you send it by bank transfer by Sunday 4 October? If it hasn't arrived by then, I'll pause lessons from Monday until it's settled. If something's come up, just tell me and we'll work out a plan.
cases.note: A parent is still a client: the amount, his own missed promise, one date and a consequence you will actually keep.

cases.situation: 我8月31日从一家餐厅离职，交接单店长陈姐签了字。劳动合同写每月10日发上月工资，我8月的工资4,600元到今天还没发。上周微信问过陈姐一次，她只回了句“老板在忙”。
cases.reply: 陈姐好，我8月的工资4,600元，按劳动合同应该在9月10日发放，到今天还没有收到。8月31日的交接单您当时已经签过字。麻烦在10月9日（周五）前转到我原来的工资卡上，或者告诉我确定的发放日期。如果需要我这边补什么材料，您直接说。
cases.note: 只讲合同、金额和日期；到期还没发，可以查一下当地劳动监察部门的投诉流程，再决定下一步。

cases.situation: I'm Alex, a freelance illustrator. Invoice #0856 for $2,300 to Brightfold Books was due September 4 and I've sent two reminders with no reply. Today their editor, Sophie, emailed asking if I can start a new cover for their spring list next week. I'd love the work.
cases.reply:
Subject: Spring cover, and invoice #0856

Hi Sophie,
Thanks for thinking of me for the spring cover, I'd love to do it. Before I start anything new, invoice #0856 for $2,300, due 4 September, needs to be settled; I've attached it again with the bank details. As soon as it's paid I can start on the cover straight away. Could you check with your finance team and let me know the payment date?
Thanks,
Alex
cases.note: Say yes to the new work and make the unpaid invoice the only thing standing before it; don't start new work while you're still owed.

cases.situation: I'm Nadia, a freelance bookkeeper. Invoice #0738 for £1,200 was dated 11 August and due 10 September; our signed agreement says payment within 30 days of the invoice date (clause 4). I emailed it to their accounts address on 11 August and again on 18 September, and now their finance contact, Fiona, says they never received it and their 30 days only start today.
cases.reply:
Hi Fiona,
Thanks for coming back to me. I've attached invoice #0738 again, along with the two emails sending it to your accounts address on 11 August and 18 September. Clause 4 of our agreement sets payment at 30 days from the invoice date, so the £1,200 was due on 10 September. Could you include it in your next payment run and confirm the date it will go out? If future invoices should go to a different address, tell me which one and I'll use it from now on.
Thanks,
Nadia
cases.note: 'Never received it' gets the proof of sending and the contract date once, no argument, plus a fix for the real cause.

cases.situation: I'm a freelance social media manager on a $1,200 monthly retainer with Brendan, who owns two cafés. Invoices go out on the 1st and are due on the 8th; for the last four months he's paid 10 to 15 days late, and only after reminders. He paid September's invoice #0905 yesterday, and October's, #1005, goes out today. I want to fix the pattern without souring things.
cases.reply: Hi Brendan, thanks for settling September's invoice #0905 yesterday. October's invoice #1005 for $1,200 is attached, due on Thursday 8 October. Over the last four months payments have arrived 10 to 15 days after the due date, and I'd rather neither of us had to think about reminders. Could you set up a recurring bank transfer of $1,200 on the 8th of each month, starting this month? If another date suits your cash flow better, tell me which and I'll move the due date to match.
cases.note: A repeat late payer: thank them for the last payment, state the pattern as a fact, and propose a system instead of another reminder.

cases.situation: 我在小区门口开五金店。老顾客王师傅做装修，7月到9月在我这赊了三次材料，一共1,380元，单子上都有他签字，当时说每月月底结，到现在一次都没结。他人挺好，我以后还想做他生意，想在微信上跟他说。
cases.reply: 王师傅，跟您对一下账：7月到9月您在店里拿了三次材料，一共1,380元，单子上都有您签字，我拍照发您。当时说的是月底结，这三个月还没结。麻烦10月10日周六前结一下，微信转账就行。一次不方便的话，先结一半，剩下的10月底前结清也可以。
cases.note: 熟客赊账也按催款写：明细、金额、原定时间和一个新日期；结清之前，先别再赊新的。

cases.situation: 大阪でフリーの翻訳をしている中村です。株式会社みなと企画あての請求書（No. 2026-0912、165,000円、支払期日9月25日（金））がまだ入金されていません。担当は広報の小林様で、取引は今回が初めてです。角が立たないように、最初の確認メールを送りたいです。
cases.reply:
小林様
お世話になっております。翻訳を担当いたしました中村です。
9月25日（金）お支払い期日の請求書（No. 2026-0912、165,000円）につきまして、本日時点でまだ入金を確認できておりませんでしたので、念のためご連絡いたしました。行き違いでご手配済みでしたら、どうぞご放念ください。請求書を改めて添付いたします。お振込先は請求書に記載のとおりです。
お手数ですが、ご確認のほどよろしくお願いいたします。
中村
cases.note: 初回は事務ミスを前提に「行き違いでしたらご放念ください」と添え、番号・金額・期日・振込先をそろえてそのまま払える形にする。

cases.situation: I'm Leon, a freelance designer. I made a logo for Ruth's bakery; invoice #0712 for $950 was due August 30. When I sent a first reminder on September 8, she replied that her husband had died in August and she'd look at it soon. Nothing since; I need the money, but I don't want to be heartless.
cases.reply:
Hi Ruth, I've thought of you often since your message, and I hope you're managing as well as anyone can. I'm writing about invoice #0712 for $950 for the bakery logo, due on 30 August, which is still open. Would paying it by Friday 30 October work for you? If it's easier, two payments of $475, one now and one by the end of November, are fine too. The bank details are on the attached invoice, and if someone else is handling the bakery's accounts at the moment, tell me who and I'll send it to them.
Leon
cases.note: A client in grief: one line of care, then the same facts and a date with more room than usual, and no consequence yet.

cases.situation: Ich bin freiberufliche Lektorin, Sabine Krüger. Meine Rechnung Nr. 2026-047 über 1.850 Euro an meinen Kunden Herrn Vogel war am 15. September fällig. Er schreibt mir, er habe schon am 14. September überwiesen, aber auf meinem Konto ist bis heute nichts angekommen.
cases.reply:
Hallo Herr Vogel,
danke für Ihre schnelle Rückmeldung. Für Rechnung Nr. 2026-047 über 1.850 Euro, fällig am 15. September, ist auf meinem Konto bis heute keine Zahlung eingegangen. Könnten Sie mir bis Montag, 5. Oktober, den Überweisungsbeleg schicken? Dann kann ich mit meiner Bank klären, wo die Zahlung geblieben ist. Bitte gleichen Sie dabei auch die IBAN mit der auf der Rechnung ab, die ich noch einmal anhänge.
Viele Grüße
Sabine Krüger
cases.note: „Schon bezahlt“ deutet meist auf einen Verwaltungsfehler: nicht widersprechen, sondern Beleg und Bankdaten abgleichen, mit Datum.

cases.situation: I'm Kai, a freelance sound designer. Invoice #0815 for $3,400 to Northlight Studio, an agency, was due 20 September; our signed agreement says payment within 30 days of invoice (clause 3) and says nothing about waiting for their client. Their producer, Priya, has just told me they'll pay 'once our client pays us, probably November'.
cases.reply:
Hi Priya,
Thanks for telling me where things stand. Our agreement is between Northlight and me, and clause 3 sets payment at 30 days from invoice, with nothing tied to your client's payment, so invoice #0815 for $3,400 was due on 20 September. Could you confirm a payment date by Friday 9 October? If cash flow is tight until your client pays, I can take $1,700 by 16 October and $1,700 by 13 November, confirmed in writing.
Thanks,
Kai
cases.note: 'We'll pay when we're paid' isn't in the contract: quote the clause once, then offer one written plan instead of an open-ended wait.

cases.situation: I'm Grace Mwangi, a freelance garden designer. Mr. Hollis paid invoice #0623 for £1,750 by cheque on 18 September, but my bank returned it unpaid on 29 September and charged me a £15 returned-item fee. Clause 8 of our agreement says bank charges caused by the client are passed on, and my bank details are on the invoice.
cases.reply:
Hi Mr. Hollis,
The cheque you sent on 18 September for invoice #0623 (£1,750) was returned unpaid by my bank on 29 September, and I was charged a £15 returned-item fee. It may just be an account mix-up, so I wanted to let you know straight away. Could you pay by bank transfer by Friday 9 October: the £1,750, plus the £15 fee under clause 8 of our agreement, £1,765 in total? My bank details are on the attached invoice.
Thanks,
Grace Mwangi
cases.note: Assume an honest mistake, give the exact new total, and ask for a different payment method so the second attempt can't fail the same way.

cases.situation: I'm Sofia Marsh, a freelance copy editor. Hartley Press finally paid invoice #0614 for $4,000 on 29 September; it was due on 15 August, so it came in 45 days late. Clause 7 of our signed agreement says payments more than 30 days late carry a flat $150 late fee, and I've prepared a separate invoice for it, #0615. My contact is Daniel and I don't want to sour things.
cases.reply:
Hi Daniel,

cases.note: Charging the late fee after payment: thank them first, quote the clause once, and give the fee its own invoice and due date. Waiving it is your call to make, not theirs.

cases.situation: I'm Maya, a freelance photographer. Invoice #0904 for $1,100 for the brand shoot at Rick's gym was due September 20. When I followed up, Rick replied offering me a free year's membership instead of paying. I don't want the membership, and I'd accept two payments of $550 if that helps him.
cases.reply: Hi Rick, thanks for the offer, that's kind, but I'll need the invoice paid in money rather than a membership. Invoice #0904 for $1,100 was due on 20 September, and the bank details are on the attached copy. Could you pay by Friday 9 October? If it's easier on cash flow, I can take $550 by 9 October and $550 by 30 October, confirmed in writing.
cases.note: An offer to pay in kind is a polite no to the invoice: decline it once, warmly, and restate amount, date and how to pay.
